fajr.TIME_TEXT: Sacchi subah (Subh Sadiq) se suryoday se theek pehle tak.

aboutUs.title: Salah Time ke baare mein
aboutUs.subtitle: Suraj ki sthiti ke aadhaar par ganana kiye gaye paanch dainik Salah samayon ki drishya margdarshika.
aboutUs.description: Salah Time aapke sthaan, tareekh aur suraj ki sthiti ke aadhaar par satik khagolIya vidhiyon se paancho dainik Salah samayon ki ganana karta hai:
aboutUs.fajr: Bhor mein kshitij par pehli roshni dikhai dene par shuru hoti hai, suraj ke kshitij se neeche ek vishesh kon ke aadhaar par ganana ki jaati hai.
aboutUs.dhuhr: Suraj ke aakash mein sabse unche bindu (saur dopahar) par pahunchne ke baad shuru hoti hai.
aboutUs.asr: Chune gaye mazhab (Hanafi ya manak) ke anusaar kisi vastu ki chhaya uske barabar ya dogunee hone par shuru hoti hai.
aboutUs.maghrib: Suraj ke kshitij se neeche doobte hi shuru hoti hai, twilight avadhi ke liye vaikalpik chhoti badhotari ke saath.
aboutUs.isha: Raat poori tarah shuru hone par shuru hoti hai, ya to Maghrib ke baad nishchit samay se ya suraj ke kshitij se neeche kon ke aadhaar par.
aboutUs.footer: Har Salah ke liye sthaaniya parampara ya vyaktigat pasand ke anusaar atirikt samayojan kiye ja sakte hain. KhagolIya ganana, sthaan aur samay offset milakar Salah Time duniya mein kahin bhi, saal ke har din ke liye satik samay sunishchit karta hai.

calc.TITLE: Hum aapke Salah ke samay ki ganana kaise karte hain
calc.INTRO: Har samay aapke phone par teen cheezon se nikala jaata hai: aapke shehar ke nirdeshank, tareekh aur suraj ki sthiti. Kisi chhape hue timetable se kuch bhi copy nahi kiya jaata, isliye kisi bhi shehar aur kisi bhi din ke samay milte hain, bina internet ke bhi.
calc.STEP_SUN: Har tareekh ke liye hum ganana karte hain ki suraj kitna uttar ya dakshin jaata hai aur dopahar ke samay mein roz hone wala chhota badlav (samay ka samikaran).
calc.STEP_NOON: Aapke shehar ke deshaantar se hum woh pal nikalte hain jab suraj aasmaan mein sabse ooncha hota hai. Zuhr uske kuch minute baad shuru hoti hai.
calc.STEP_ANGLES: Fajr aur Isha woh pal hain jab suraj kshitij se ek tay kon neeche hota hai. Suryoday aur Maghrib tab hote hain jab suraj ka upari kinara kshitij paar karta hai, hawa se roshni ke mudne ko dhyan mein rakhkar. Asr ko parchhai ki lambai se naapa jaata hai.
calc.METHODS_INTRO: Ulama aur Islami sansthayein Fajr aur Isha ke liye suraj ke alag-alag kon istemaal karti hain. Woh tareeka chunein jise aapki local Masjid maanti hai.
calc.ANGLE_NOTE: Kon kshitij se neeche suraj ke degree hain. Bada kon hone par Fajr jaldi aur Isha der se hoti hai.
calc.ASR_HANAFI: Hanafi: Asr tab shuru hoti hai jab kisi cheez ki parchhai uski lambai ki dogunee ho jaye, dopahar ki parchhai ke alawa.
calc.ASR_SHAFII: Shafi'i, Maliki aur Hanbali: Asr tab shuru hoti hai jab kisi cheez ki parchhai uski lambai ke barabar ho jaye, dopahar ki parchhai ke alawa.
calc.LIVE_DAILY: Har tareekh ke liye dobara ganana hoti hai, isliye samay roz mausam ke saath badalte hain.
calc.LIVE_CHANGES: Shehar, tareeka, maslak ya adjustment badalte hi turant update hota hai.
calc.LIVE_COUNTDOWN: Maujooda Namaz aur uska countdown har second update hota hai.
calc.LIVE_LOCATION: Maujooda location chalu hone par har baar app kholne par aapka shehar update hota hai, isliye safar mein bhi samay aapke saath rehte hain.
calc.LIVE_TIMEZONE: Samay chune hue shehar ke sthaaniya samay mein dikhte hain, daylight saving samet.
calc.LIVE_HIJRI: Hijri tareekh aapke desh ki chaand dekhne ki ghoshnaon ke anusaar hoti hai, jise hamari team update karti hai.
calc.ACCURACY: Ek hi tareeke ke liye, ganana kiye gaye samay aam taur par chhape timetable se kuch minute ke andar milte hain. Kai Masjidein ehtiyaat ke liye kuch minute jodti hain, isliye agar aapki Masjid ka samay alag hai to Settings mein Salah adjustment se mila lein.

adjustSalahTimes: Salah samay adjust karne ke liye maanon ka upyog karein.

SETTINGS_PAGE.HIJRI_OFFSET_HELP: Hijri tareekh aapki chuni hui location ke hisaab se hoti hai. Agar aapki local masjid ek din aage ya peeche hai, to yahan badlein.
SETTINGS_PAGE.NOTIFICATION_HELP: Alarm bharosemand rakhne ke liye: SalahTime ke liye battery optimization band karein aur background gatividhi anumati dein, khaaskar MIUI, ColorOS aur isi tarah ke Android skin par.
